title: New York Post posts photos of Mike Vrabel in Salt Lake City on Saturday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: New York Post posts photos of Mike Vrabel in Salt Lake City on Saturday
sources.description: In the aftermath of the April 7 publication by the New York Post of photos featuring Patriots coach Mike Vrabel and NFL reporter Dianna Russini at a resort in Arizona, Vrabel has become the subject of a search for any existing images.
